gloss: exhibiting; displaying at an exhibition or trade show

definitions.gloss: exhibiting, displaying at an exhibition or trade show
definitions.explanation: The act of presenting products, artworks, or other items at an exhibition, trade fair, or show. Refers to both the act of exhibiting and participation as an exhibitor.

examples.japanese: {展示会|てんじかい}に{出展|しゅってん}する。
{今年|ことし}の{美術展|びじゅつてん}に{作品|さくひん}を{出展|しゅってん}した。
examples.english: I exhibited a work at this year's art exhibition.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}の{見本市|みほんいち}に{出展|しゅってん}して{自社|じしゃ}{製品|せいひん}をアピールする{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: We plan to exhibit at an overseas trade fair to promote our products.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{展示会|てんじかい}に{出展|しゅってん}する (exhibit at a trade show)
・{出展|しゅってん}{企業|きぎょう} (exhibiting company)
・{出展|しゅってん}{者|しゃ} (exhibitor)
・{出展|しゅってん}ブース (exhibition booth)

USAGE NOTES:
Not to be confused with the homophone {出典|しゅってん} (source, reference — used for citing where information comes from). {出展|しゅってん} uses {展|てん} (exhibit/display), while {出典|しゅってん} uses {典|てん} (canon/classic). Both are common words, so context is important to distinguish them.
